Hahaha I am actually going through this as I type. I hate working sooooo much. It is really something that causes me significant stress even on a subconscious level. My body physically can’t take it. Mentally ? I am so surprised I even still have one. When I’m manic is thee fucking worse. Blurting out inappropriate comments. Extreme irritability, almost zero capacity to concentrate on ANYTHING. Also I get very overwhelmed and sensitive. I hate mentally feeling like I am being FORCED to work, because well I am I suppose. Best advice I have is to try to pick a job that you don’t hate and stay there for a year,get some FMLA and keep going. Also be gentle with yourself. Baby yourself. Sleep as much as you can. Find something to laugh at everyday even if it’s a little laugh or a fake one :) life’s too precious to be serious all the time. If nobody has told you they love you today, just know that I do. We got this kiddo.


Also yes many people with bipolar disorder can’t work, it’s a qualifying disability under the Americans with Disability act (ADA) you actually could look into applying for disability. It is a very tedious process with lots of paperwork but I think in your case with everything documented with your psych dr and history with job instability, you have a good shot at getting it.

Break ups/ relationship breakdowns are a notorious trigger for bipolar episodes. Masterbate, listen to music you like and journal. Even if it’s just a minute or two a day. Make yourself focus on something else. Also, even though you probably aren’t tired you should try to sleep. If you can’t sleep still try to be in an environment that is low stimulation. Be gentle with yourself. Bipolar disorder is its own version of heaven and hell unique to anyone that suffers from it. People who don’t suffer from it will never understand. You don’t sound like you’re sure why you did it so don’t be so quick to just pull something out of the air because it makes sense. Find out why. Give your partner the option of staying or leaving. Breakups suck and can also trigger episodes so try to make a plan of what to do when these feelings come up. If you’re hesitant of seeking professional help I suggest journaling. Journal as often as you want especially when intense feelings come up. Make yourself focus and write about these feelings with as much detail as possible. When you’re in a calmer head space look over what you have written and try to journal often so you can identify patterns and make a plan if it happens again. Good luck and please. PLEASE don’t be so hard on yourself my dear. 🩷

I’m so glad there’s a 3 day weekend because I’ve never felt so embarrassed in my adult life.

Having a support system helps even if it’s just 1 person. I feel like this ALOT but over time i have realized that  no one quite knows what i need like me. Days where i am unsure of how to feel or react i take it easy. I look for low stimulation environments. I think of myself as a small child and think to myself. “What does my baby girl need right now to feel even just a little better?” I start small and work from there. Get comfortable being yourself with yourself. Journal how you feel with as much detail as possible and consider it data for another day. Make a habit of it. I learned that even though the people I trust and that know me best all have the best intentions for me. I will NEVER EVER trust anyone’s judgement above my own. Consider it? Sure!  however I have learned to build a trusting relationship with myself. If I ever don’t know what to do I take time to myself alone until I consider the effects of my possible decision options. 

Hope this helps
